title: I&P GN - SC&E – Analyst - S&P - Indirect Analysis
description:
**ROLE SUMMARY**


We are seeking a Senior Solution Architect to lead the design of scalable, secure, and cost\-effective solutions across cloud and enterprise systems. Acting as the bridge between business objectives and engineering execution, you will translate requirements into robust architecture blueprints, define technical standards, and guide delivery teams from design through production. This role combines strategic technical leadership with hands\-on depth; you will make high\-impact technology decisions, champion best practices, and ensure solutions meet demanding non\-functional requirements around performance, security, resilience, and cost.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Define end\-to\-end solution architectures that align with business goals, enterprise standards, and long\-term technology strategy.
* Translate business and functional requirements into clear technical designs, high\-level and low\-level design documents, and architecture blueprints.
* Evaluate, recommend, and select technologies, frameworks, and platforms, including build\-vs\-buy and cloud\-provider decisions.
* Design cloud\-native, microservices, event\-driven, and API\-first architectures for scalability and maintainability.
* Define and govern non\-functional requirements \- scalability, performance, availability, security, resilience, and cost optimization.
* Lead architecture and design reviews, establish coding and design standards, and drive technical governance across teams.
* Partner with product managers, business stakeholders, security, and infrastructure teams; present architecture and trade\-offs to senior leadership and clients.
* Provide hands\-on technical leadership and mentorship to development teams, unblocking complex engineering challenges.
* Build proofs\-of\-concept and prototypes to validate architectural approaches and de\-risk delivery.
* Embed security and compliance by design across the solution lifecycle.
* Champion DevOps, CI/CD, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code adoption to improve delivery speed and quality.
* Operate within Agile/Scrum delivery models, contributing to estimation, roadmap planning, and iterative delivery.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent hands\-on experience.
* 7\+ years in software engineering, including proven experience in a solution, technical, or application architect capacity.
* Demonstrated track record designing and delivering large\-scale, distributed, production systems.
* Deep, hands\-on expertise with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Strong command of microservices, API design, and enterprise integration patterns.
* A solid engineering foundation with hands\-on coding experience in one or more major languages (e.g., Java, .NET, Python, Node.js).
* Strong understanding of application/data security, DevOps practices, and system integration.
* Demonstrated experience delivering solutions in Agile and Scrum environments.
* Excellent stakeholder communication skills, including the ability to present complex technical concepts to non\-technical audiences.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS (NICE\-TO\-HAVE)**

* Experience in Data Engineering \- designing data pipelines, data lakes/warehouses, streaming, and big\-data platforms (e.g., Spark, Kafka, Snowflake, Databricks).
* Recognized architecture certifications (e.g., AWS/Azure/GCP Solutions Architect, TOGAF).
* Experience integrating enterprise platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, or similar.
* Experience with event\-driven and streaming architectures at scale.
* Domain experience in analytics, data\-intensive, or large enterprise product environments.
* Pre\-sales or consulting exposure, including solution shaping and effort estimation.

**TECHNICAL SKILLS**

* **Architecture:** Microservices, event\-driven, API\-first, domain\-driven design, integration patterns, EA frameworks (e.g., TOGAF)
* **Cloud:** AWS / Azure / GCP, serverless, containers (Kubernetes), Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation)
* **Development:** Java, .NET, Python, or Node.js; REST, GraphQL, gRPC
* **Data \& Messaging:** SQL \& NoSQL, data modelling, caching, messaging/streaming (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
* **Security:** IAM, OAuth 2\.0 / OIDC, encryption, zero\-trust and secure\-by\-design principles
* **DevOps \& Modelling:** CI/CD, observability, SRE practices; UML and C4 architecture modelling

**SOFT SKILLS**

* Technical leadership and the ability to influence without direct authority.
* Strategic thinking balanced with pragmatic, hands\-on execution.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management across business and technology.
* Confident decision\-making under ambiguity and competing constraints.
* Mentorship and a genuine commitment to growing engineering talent.
* Strong facilitation and negotiation skills across cross\-functional teams.

title: I&P GN - SC&E – Senior Manager - Enterprise AI Value Strategy-EVS
description:
**Job Description**


The ideal candidate for a Senior Manager in the Supply Chain team shall be,

* A subject matter expert in application of data science methodologies in one or more areas of supply chain analytics: Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Network Design, Logistics, Procurement, Manufacturing, After Market, or Control Tower
* Create new innovative offerings and lead workstreams in their area of expertise; demonstrate thought leadership which helps the growth of the Practice via new client work and more trained team members.
* Support business development and communicate with leaders in client teams to understand business challenges, be the solution architect, design and get buy\-in for the analytics solution and serve as delivery lead of one or more Manager\-led teams during project execution


Job Qualifications

**Experience and Education:**

* Ideal candidates should have a Ph.D. or a Master’s degree in a quantitative discipline like Statistics/ Economics/ Operations Research/Computer Science, etc.
* Work experience in data science applications should be 11\+ years after Master’s degree or 8\+ years after Ph.D., with at least 7 years in advanced analytics solutions design and delivery experience in supply chain/logistics/manufacturing/ production. Global client experience is a plus.
* Certifications in any one or two of the areas will be an added advantage: Python, AI/ML, Generative AI, Agentic AI, Optimization, Simulation, data science application on any of the cloud platforms (Azure/ GCP/ AWS).

  

**Mandatory Skills:**

* Deep experience in creating innovative solutions and delivering projects using data science in at least one of the supply chain functional areas: Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Network Design, Logistics, Procurement, Manufacturing, After Market, or Control Tower
* Expertise in use of data science for supply chain planning and operations of any of the major industries: Consumer Goods, Retail, Life sciences, Industrial, and Resources
* Expert in creating solutions using one or more data science areas like Generative AI, Agentic AI, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Statistics, Operations Research
* Experience in leading work delivered via large project teams across multiple workstreams
* Strong skills in presentation of complex concepts and large\-scale project work to senior stakeholders
* Hands\-on programming experience with any of the analytics tools, data bases and visualization tools and platforms (e.g., Python, PySpark, SQL)

title: Senior OKE & Kubernetes Platform Engineer
description:
**Role description**  

**Job Summary**
We are seeking a highly skilled **Senior OKE \& Kubernetes Platform Engineer** with extensive experience in **Oracle Kubernetes Engine (OKE)** and **Kubernetes**, along with working knowledge of **Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)**. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing enterprise\-scale OKE clusters, resolving complex production issues, ensuring platform reliability, scalability, and operational excellence, and providing technical leadership for Kubernetes platform operations.
Key Responsibilities
* Manage, administer, and support production\-grade **OKE** and **Kubernetes** clusters.
* Perform cluster lifecycle management activities, including upgrades, maintenance, patching, and capacity planning.
* Lead the resolution of critical platform incidents related to clusters, nodes, pods, networking, storage, and performance.
* Troubleshoot complex issues across Kubernetes environments and OCI\-hosted infrastructure.
* Monitor platform health, availability, and performance to ensure reliable operations.
* Collaborate with application, cloud, and security teams to deliver stable and scalable Kubernetes platforms.
* Support platform optimization initiatives to improve reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to L1/L2 engineers supporting Kubernetes operations.
* Participate in root cause analysis and implement preventive measures for recurring platform issues.
* Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement across Kubernetes and OKE environments.

**Required Skills**
### **Proficient**


* OKE
* Kubernetes

### **Intermediate**


* OCI

Experience
* 8\-12\+ years of overall IT experience.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on Kubernetes administration experience.
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience with Oracle Kubernetes Engine (OKE).
* Experience supporting large\-scale, customer\-facing production environments.
* Strong troubleshooting and incident management capabilities.

Preferred Certifications
* Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
* Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)
* OCI Architect Associate/Professional
* Terraform Associate

What We Are Looking For
* Strong troubleshooting mindset and ownership of critical incidents.
* Ability to work independently and drive technical solutions across cross\-functional teams.
* Experience supporting enterprise\-scale production Kubernetes platforms.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong focus on platform reliability, stability, and operational excellence.

Why Join UST
UST delivers technology\-led solutions that help global organizations accelerate digital transformation and innovation. You will have the opportunity to work on modern cloud\-native platforms, collaborate with global teams, solve complex engineering challenges, and grow your career through continuous learning and development opportunities.
  

**Skills**  

Oracle Container Engine for Kubernetes, Kubernetes, OCI

 **About UST**  

UST is a global digital transformation solutions provider. For more than 20 years, UST has worked side by side with the world’s best companies to make a real impact through transformation. Powered by technology, inspired by people and led by purpose, UST partners with their clients from design to operation. With deep domain expertise and a future\-proof philosophy, UST embeds innovation and agility into their clients’ organizations. With over 30,000 employees in 30 countries, UST builds for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process.

title: Staff Engineer I - Software Development Insight
description:
**Position Overview**


We are looking for a Staff Full Stack Engineer to drive the technical architecture and strategic development of our cloud\-based NMS platform. This role combines deep networking expertise with full\-stack engineering leadership to build enterprise\-grade solutions that manage complex network infrastructures for our global customer base.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Platform Architecture**: Design scalable, multi\-tenant architecture for managing thousands of network devices across customer environments
* **Advanced Network Analytics**: Lead development of AI/ML\-powered network analytics, predictive maintenance, and automated troubleshooting capabilities
* **Enterprise Integration**: Architect integrations with major network vendors' management platforms and enterprise IT systems
* **Performance Engineering**: Optimize platform performance for handling massive telemetry data streams from network devices
* **Security Architecture**: Design zero\-trust security models for secure device access and customer data protection
* **API Strategy**: Lead design of comprehensive APIs for network automation, third\-party integrations, and customer workflows
* **Edge Computing**: Develop edge gateway solutions for on\-premises network management in hybrid deployments
* **Scalability Planning**: Architect solutions supporting enterprise customers with 10,000\+ managed devices
* **Technical Leadership**: Mentor engineering teams and establish best practices for network software development
* **Customer Success**: Work directly with enterprise customers on complex technical requirements and custom integrations

**Advanced Technical Requirements**

* **Network Expertise**: Deep knowledge of enterprise networking, SDN/SD\-WAN, network virtualization, and modern networking protocols
* **Distributed Systems**: Expert\-level experience with microservices, event\-driven architecture, and distributed data processing
* **Real\-time Processing**: Advanced experience with stream processing (Kafka, Apache Storm) for handling network telemetry at scale
* **Machine Learning**: Experience applying ML to network analytics, anomaly detection, and predictive maintenance
* **Network Security**: Deep understanding of network security protocols, certificate management, and secure device provisioning
* **Multi\-vendor Integration**: Extensive experience with network vendor APIs and management protocols across different manufacturers
* **Performance Optimization**: Expert knowledge of database optimization for time\-series data and high\-throughput network metrics
* **Cloud Networking**: Advanced knowledge of cloud networking services, VPC design, and hybrid cloud architectures

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering, or Electrical Engineering
* 14\+ years of software development experience with 5\+ years in network management systems
* Deep understanding of enterprise networking technologies and network operations centers (NOC)
* Experience with major network vendors (Cisco, Juniper, Aruba, Fortinet, etc.) and their management APIs
* Proven track record building SaaS platforms serving enterprise customers
* Experience with network certification programs (CCNA/CCNP knowledge preferred)
* Strong background in both software engineering and network infrastructure

**Company Statement/Values:**


At NETGEAR, we are on a mission to unleash the full potential of connectivity with intelligent solutions that delight and protect. We turn ideas into innovative networking products that connect people, power businesses, and advance the way we live.


We're a performance\-driven, talented and connected team that's committed to delivering world\-class products for our customers. As a company, we value our employees as the most essential building blocks of our success. And as teammates, we commit to taking our work to the *Next Gear* by living our values: we **Dare to Transform** the future, **Connect and Delight** our customers, **Communicate Courageously** with each other and collaborate to **Win It Together**. You’ll find our values woven through our processes, present in our decisions, and celebrated throughout our culture.


We strive to attract top talent and create a great workplace where people feel engaged, inspired, challenged, proud and respected. If you are creative, forward\-thinking, passionate about technology and are looking for a rewarding career to make an impact, then you've got what it takes to succeed at NETGEAR. Join our network and help us shape the future of connectivity.

*NETGEAR hires based on merit. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.*

title: Software Engineering Senior Analyst - Cigna Healthcare
description:
Overview
  
  

Cigna International Health is undertaking a strategic transformation programme to modernise its customer portals and self\-service applications, supporting the growth of our health businesses globally.
  
We are seeking an experiencedSenior React Native Developer to build and enhance our next\-generation mobile applications. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise inReact Native, TypeScript, mobile architecture, and API integration, with a passion for delivering high\-quality, performant, and secure mobile experiences.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
  

Mobile Application Development
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain high\-quality mobile applications usingReact Native for iOS and Android.
* Build reusable, scalable, and maintainable components aligned with our design system.
* Ensure excellent user experience, performance, accessibility, and application stability.
* Integrate mobile applications with backend APIs using secure authentication mechanisms.


Engineering Excellence
  
  

* Write clean, testable, and maintainable code following modern software engineering practices.
* Implement automated testing strategies and adopt Test\-Driven Development (TDD) where appropriate.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to development standards and best practices.
* Troubleshoot and resolve performance, reliability, and security issues.


Collaboration Delivery
  
  

* Work closely with Product Owners, Architects, Designers, and Backend Engineers to deliver business value.
* Contribute to Agile delivery processes and iterative software development.
* Support CI/CD implementation and mobile release processes for the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.


Mentoring
  
  

* Mentor and support junior developers.
* Promote a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and engineering excellence.


Requirements
  
  

Experience
  
  

* 6 years of software development experience, with significant experience building enterprise mobile applications usingReact Native.
* Proven experience delivering applications to the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.


Technical Skills
  
  

**Must have strong experience in:**  

* React Native
* React
* TypeScript / JavaScript (ES6\)
* Mobile application architecture and design patterns
* Redux / Redux Toolkit or similar state management libraries
* REST API integration
* OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT, or token\-based authentication
* Mobile testing frameworks and automated testing practices
* Git\-based source control workflows


**Experience with:**  

* CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, Bamboo, etc.)
* Performance optimisation and debugging mobile applications
* Agile development methodologies


Desirable
  
  

* Full\-stack development experience (Node.js, NestJS, Java, .NET, or similar)

We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

  



***Job Family Definition:***


Designs, analyzes, develops, modifies and evaluates VLSI components and hardware systems. Determines architecture and logic design, design verification through software developed for component and system simulation, and builds physical implementations through development of multidimensional designs involving the layout of complex integrated circuits. Analyzes designs to establish operating data, conducts experimental tests and evaluates results to enable prototype and production VLSI solutions. May direct support personnel in the preparation of detailed design, design testing and prototype fabrication.

 ***Management Level Definition:***


Contributions include applying intermediate level of subject matter expertise to solve common technical problems. Acts as an informed team member providing analysis of information and recommendations for appropriate action. Works independently within an established framework and with moderate supervision.

 **What You'll Do**

* Develop and enhance ASIC verification environments using the latest methodologies such as UVM.
* Architect and build block\-level, subsystem, and full\-chip verification environments using SystemVerilog and UVM.
* Define, design, and execute verification suites and test cases for complex ASICs using front\-end simulators such as VCS and NC.
* Independently verify large ASIC blocks and drive tape\-out readiness through code coverage, functional coverage, and gate\-level simulation analysis.
* Collaborate with logic designers to debug and resolve design issues, and work with software teams during bring\-up and validation.
* Develop Perl, Python, and/or Shell scripts to improve verification infrastructure, automation, and methodology.

 **What You Need to Bring**

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering (BSEE/MSEE).
* 3\+ years of experience in ASIC Verification.
* Strong experience with SystemVerilog for ASIC verification.
* Experience with constrained\-random verification techniques.
* Hands\-on experience with industry\-standard verification methodologies such as OVM, VMM, or UVM.
* Proficiency in Perl, Tcl, Python, or Shell scripting (Perl/Tcl preferred).
* Experience verifying networking protocols such as Ethernet is a plus.
* Strong problem\-solving, debugging, and ASIC verification skills.
* Excellent analytical and collaboration skills.

title: Manager, Platform Engineering
description:
**About Vista Equity Partners**
===============================



Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology\-enabled businesses. With over $100B in assets under management and a portfolio of 90\+ software product companies worldwide, Vista accelerates growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long\-term partnership. In India, Vista’s presence continues to expand with 45\+ portfolio companies employing more than 17,000 professionals across technology, product, customer success, and operations — reinforcing India’s strategic role as a hub of innovation and talent within the Vista ecosystem.



Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is embedding Generative AI across its global portfolio — enabling companies to integrate intelligent, responsible AI into products, operations, and decision\-making. This initiative is strengthened through portfolio\-wide learning programs, leadership workshops, and AI hackathons that foster innovation, build fluency, and accelerate practical AI adoption across teams.


**About Amtech**
================



Amtech is a leading provider of enterprise software solutions for the packaging, printing, and manufacturing industries. Our integrated systems streamline order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics — empowering customers to drive efficiency, reduce costs, and improve operational performance. With a strong commitment to innovation and customer success, Amtech delivers reliable technology backed by deep industry expertise.



With Vista’s investment and strategic guidance, we combine the agility of a growing technology organization with the scale, stability, and career mobility of a global software ecosystem.


**Our Employee Value Proposition**  

  

At Amtech, our people are our greatest differentiator. We create an environment where you can:  

  

**Purpose**  

Shape the future of manufacturing and supply chain operations by delivering mission\-critical enterprise software used by industry\-leading organizations.  

**Growth**  

Access continuous learning, leadership development, and cross\-portfolio opportunities through Vista’s global network — accelerating both technical and managerial career paths.  

**Culture**  

Work in a collaborative, transparent, and people\-first environment where values, accountability, and integrity guide every decision.  

**Innovation**  

Engage with cutting\-edge technologies, including AI\-driven automation, and contribute to modernizing financial systems and operational processes across the business.


**Role Description**
====================



Amtech is executing an all\-in AWS strategy: migrating our flagship Encore ERP to a multi\-account, account\-per\-customer AWS architecture, operating LabelTraxx as a multi\-tenant SaaS platform, and retiring legacy private\-cloud infrastructure over time. Platform Engineering owns the landing zone, infrastructure as code, and the golden\-path tooling that product teams build on, and the reliability of everything that runs on it.



The Manager, Platform Engineering (India) leads the India Cloud and Platform SRE teams: the engineers who build the AWS platform and the engineers who keep it running. You own the people, the delivery, and the day\-to\-day technical leadership of that group under the guidance of the VP, working alongside the Cloud Architect, who owns platform architecture. The scope spans two engineering disciplines and a direct interface to IT/IS/PE leadership and vendors.


This is a player\-coach role by design: leadership first, hands\-on second. Leadership means hiring and building the team, developing engineers, running the operating cadence, and representing Platform Engineering within IT/IS/PE and to partner functions. Hands\-on means staying close enough to the code and the incidents to make good calls, review the changes that matter most, and lead incident response in India hours. As the team matures, the balance shifts further toward leadership without leaving the technical work behind.


You will work daily with the U.S.\-based Senior Manager who leads Customer SRE, the Senior SRE who owns the reliability standards both SRE teams operate on, the Sr. Director of Information Security, and the VP. This role is the first people\-leadership position in Platform Engineering India.


**SCOPE \& AUTHORITY**


* Leads hiring for the India Cloud and Platform SRE teams in partnership with Talent Acquisition; offers follow Amtech's approval process. The role leads interviews and makes the hiring recommendation for each open India position.
* Owns performance, leveling, and development decisions for direct reports within Amtech's leveling framework.
* Sets sprint priorities and capacity allocation for the India teams within the Platform Engineering roadmap.
* Holds incident command for platform incidents in India hours.
* Runs the architecture review and holds the team to its outcomes; the Cloud Architect approves architecture decisions, and decisions affecting security controls require Information Security sign\-off.
* Leads technical evaluation of platform vendors and tooling with the Cloud Architect; recommends spend and contract changes to the VP, who holds approval.
* Participates in the IT/IS/PE leadership team as needed; Platform Engineering's representative in India site leadership forums.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**
===================


**People Leadership**


* Lead, hire, and develop the India Cloud and Platform SRE teams, a team that is growing through 2027 with hosted customer count and product engineering headcount and that this role hires into from day one.
* Own performance management, career development, and leveling under Amtech's leveling framework; grow senior engineers into technical leads and future managers.
* Set the operating cadence for the India teams: sprint ceremonies, on\-call rotations, triage duty, and the follow\-the\-sun handoff with the U.S.
* Build a team culture of ownership, blameless postmortems, and written decision\-making that holds across time zones.
* Give engineers credit publicly and feedback privately.


**Architecture \& Technical Strategy**


* Deliver the AWS platform roadmap set with the Cloud Architect, who owns architecture: multi\-account organization, landing zone, networking, identity, and the account\-per\-customer Encore tenancy model.
* Plan and deliver Encore\-on\-AWS environment builds (temporary, production, demo) on the shared golden IaC stack, and LabelTraxx platform work, against the roadmap.
* Run the architecture review: decisions are recorded as ADRs, reviewed with the Senior SRE, and approved by the Cloud Architect. Make sure decisions are made on time and carried through by the team.
* Evaluate and integrate emerging capabilities, including AI\-assisted and agentic engineering tooling, within Amtech's AI governance guardrails.


**Platform Engineering \& Delivery**


* Hold the technical bar for infrastructure code: enforce module standards set with the Cloud Architect, review the highest\-blast\-radius changes, and write code where it unblocks the team.
* Operate and enforce standards for CI/CD (GitHub Actions), progressive delivery, environment promotion, and secrets management.
* Drive automation of environment provisioning so a new hosted customer is a pipeline run, not a project; publish and hit onboarding time targets.
* Own delivery against the Platform Engineering roadmap: sprint commitments, capacity budgets (strategic versus tactical), and the response commitments made to requesters.


**Reliability \& Operations**


* Own delivery of production reliability for the shared platform in India hours, operating on the SLO frameworks, observability architecture (OpenTelemetry, OpenObserve, CloudWatch), and PagerDuty service models set by the Senior SRE.
* Hold authority to deviate from a reliability standard during an active incident, restore the standard when the incident closes, and raise a postmortem item to ratify or revert the change. Propose standard changes to the Senior SRE, who decides; the VP arbitrates.
* Lead major incident response for platform incidents in India hours; own postmortems and the remediation backlog.
* Own patching, backup and restore testing, disaster recovery exercises, and capacity management on a published calendar.
* Extend observability to AI workloads so usage, performance, and spend are visible in the same plane as compute.


**Security, Compliance \& Cost**


* Implement and enforce security architecture with Information Security and the Cloud Architect: IAM boundaries, network segmentation, encryption, and data governance for customer data.
* Ensure the platform satisfies SOC 2 and ISO 27001 obligations by design, with audit evidence generated through automation.
* Drive FinOps outcomes with Finance: tagging governance, right\-sizing, Savings Plans coverage, unit cost visibility, and input to the AWS enterprise commit.
* Surface technical and delivery risk to the VP early: sequencing, vendor dependencies, and single points of failure.


**AI Competency**


* Adopt agentic and AI\-assisted engineering workflows for the team within the autonomy tiers, guardrails, and auditability set by Platform Engineering; measure productivity against baselines.
* Apply the validation layers (schema, rules, model\-graded, human review) appropriate to each change by blast radius.
* Prevent AI\-generated code from degrading platform quality at fleet scale: evaluation harnesses, complexity metrics, and AI\-attributed defect tracking.
* Mentor engineers in safe, high\-leverage AI usage; enforce data classification policy in all AI\-assisted work.


**Cross\-Functional Leadership**


* Partner with the Customer SRE leader so the platform the India team builds and the environments Customer SRE runs evolve together.
* Partner with the Senior SRE on reliability standards: implement and enforce them in India and feed operational learning back.
* Serve as senior technical counterpart to AWS, consulting partners, and third\-party providers on funded programs in India hours.
* Report team delivery, reliability, and risk clearly to IT/IS/PE leadership; support integration work for acquisitions.


Ensure knowledge is durable: documentation, runbooks, and deliberate succession planning so no platform capability depends on one person, including you


**WORKING HOURS**



Core hours are India business hours. The role carries a scheduled overlap window with U.S. leadership for architecture reviews and leadership syncs, set in the team operating cadence. Incident command applies in India hours; weekend paging is P0 only and rotates across the team rather than resting on this role.


**QUALIFICATIONS**


**Must have**


* Hands\-on AWS platform experience in a multi\-account environment: landing zones, account vending, IAM, and networking, at a level that lets you review your team's work credibly.
* Strong Terraform and IaC experience: working in a shared module ecosystem with testing and versioning discipline.
* 2\+ years leading engineers as a people manager with direct responsibility for hiring, performance, and development, within 12\+ years of progressive engineering experience.
* Experience leading production operations under SLOs: on\-call design, incident command, postmortems, and observability with OpenTelemetry or equivalent.


**Strongly preferred**


* Designed AI\-assisted or agentic engineering systems with guardrails, autonomy tiers, and measured ROI; L4\+ AI competency by industry frameworks.
* Strong software engineering foundation (Python, Go, or similar) and fluency with modern CI/CD (GitHub Actions or equivalent).
* Working command of cloud security architecture and compliance\-driven design (SOC 2, ISO 27001\).


**Preferred**


* Track record of building and retaining a high\-performing engineering team in a distributed, multi\-time\-zone organization.
* Communicates decisions in writing clearly enough that executives act on them and engineers execute them without a meeting.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrated skills.
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional or DevOps Engineer Professional.
* Experience with multi\-tenant SaaS and account\-per\-customer tenancy economics.
* Experience architecting and executing large migrations (data center or private cloud to AWS), including ERP\-class or other stateful enterprise workloads.
* Experience in a private equity portfolio company, M\&A integration, or investor\-facing technical diligence.
* Experience building an engineering team in India for a U.S.\-headquartered company, including leveling frameworks and retention programs.
* FinOps practice experience: tagging governance, Savings Plans strategy, cost allocation, enterprise commit negotiation.
* Experience establishing AI/LLM platform capabilities or agent\-based automation under formal governance.


**SUCCESS IN THE FIRST YEAR**


* Every India Cloud and Platform SRE engineer has a named manager, a leveled role, a development plan, and a clear on\-call and triage rotation.
* The golden IaC stack has a documented owner and a succession plan; no platform capability depends on one person.
* New hosted customer environment provisioning time is published and improving quarter over quarter.
* SLO attainment for the shared platform is published monthly and meets target; platform incidents in India hours are led, resolved, and written up to the standard the Senior SRE sets for both SRE teams.
* The AWS enterprise commit is negotiated from a known baseline with FinOps discipline behind it.
* The team is one you would be proud to hand to the manager you are developing to replace you.

 **Why Join Amtech**
===================



At Amtech, you will drive meaningful financial impact in a growing enterprise software organization while benefiting from Vista’s world\-class ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented peers, leverage cross\-portfolio learning programs, and help shape the future of Amtech’s financial operations and systems. Build your career with Amtech — backed by the strength, scale, and innovation culture of Vista.

title: AI/ML Silicon Emulation Lead, Google Cloud, TPU
description:
In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience in electrical engineering, coding, and emulation.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture.
* Experience with EDA debug tools (e.g., Verdi, SimVision/Indago, GDB).
* Experience with programming and scripting in C, C\+\+, Python, Perl, or TCL.
* Understanding of SoC architecture and interfaces (e.g., AXI, DDR, PCIe, etc.).
* Understanding of RTL to emulation/FPGA flows including emulation test benches (e.g., transactors/accelerated VIPs, hybrid, in\-circuit emulation).

**About the job**
-----------------


In this role, you’ll work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration. You will have an opportunity to drive cutting\-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. You’ll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's TPU. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide, and leverage your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML\-driven systems.


The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.


We're the driving team behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Build full chip emulation or FPGA prototypes from complex SoC designs and deliver to multiple customers such as software, firmware, platform and post\-silicon validation teams.
* Bring up system level emulation models through reset, boot, and bare metal content or OS.
* Influence the design and verification teams to add emulation friendly model development.
* Work with architects, designers, software engineers, pre and post\-silicon verification engineers to develop test plans, coverage, and reproduce failures on emulation.
* Develop, execute, and debug full\-chip/system on a chip (SoC) tests on Emulation platforms. Explore new verification and emulation methodologies and implement them.

description:
**About Vista Equity Partners**



Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology\-enabled businesses. With over $100B in assets under management and a portfolio of 90\+ software product companies worldwide, Vista accelerates growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long\-term partnership. In India, Vista’s presence continues to expand with 45\+ portfolio companies employing more than 17,000 professionals across technology, product, customer success, and operations — reinforcing India’s strategic role as a hub of innovation and talent within the Vista ecosystem.



Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is embedding Generative AI across its global portfolio — enabling companies to integrate intelligent, responsible AI into products, operations, and decision\-making. This initiative is strengthened through portfolio\-wide learning programs, leadership workshops, and AI hackathons that foster innovation, build fluency, and accelerate practical AI adoption across teams.


**About Amtech**



Amtech is a leading provider of enterprise software solutions for the packaging, printing, and manufacturing industries. Our integrated systems streamline order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics — empowering customers to drive efficiency, reduce costs, and improve operational performance. With a strong commitment to innovation and customer success, Amtech delivers reliable technology backed by deep industry expertise.



With Vista’s investment and strategic guidance, we combine the agility of a growing technology organization with the scale, stability, and career mobility of a global software ecosystem.


**Our Employee Value Proposition**  

At Amtech, our people are our greatest differentiators. We create an environment where you can:  

**Purpose**  

Shape the future of manufacturing and supply chain operations by delivering mission\-critical enterprise software used by industry\-leading organizations.


**Growth**  

Access continuous learning, leadership development, and cross\-portfolio opportunities through Vista’s global network — accelerating both technical and managerial career paths.


**Culture**  

Work in a collaborative, transparent, and people\-first environment where values, accountability, and integrity guide every decision.


**Innovation**  

Engage with cutting\-edge technologies, including AI\-driven automation, and contribute to modernizing financial systems and operational processes across the business.


**Role Description**



Amtech is executing an all\-in AWS strategy: migrating our flagship Encore ERP to a multi\-account, account\-per\-customer AWS architecture, operating LabelTraxx as a multi\-tenant SaaS platform, and retiring legacy private\-cloud infrastructure. Platform Engineering owns the landing zone, infrastructure as code, and the golden\-path tooling that product teams build on.



As a Senior Platform Engineer on the Cloud track, you will design and build core AWS infrastructure, own significant components of the Encore\-on\-AWS environment build system, and set the technical standard for the India cloud engineering pod.



This is a senior hands\-on role: you will ship infrastructure, review others' work, and mentor engineers while coordinating closely with U.S.\-based architects and leadership.



**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**


**Architecture \& Design**


* Design and implement scalable, secure AWS infrastructure across Amtech's multi\-account organizations, including our account\-per\-customer Encore hosting model.
* Author and maintain the reusable Terraform modules and golden\-path IaC patterns that other engineers build on.
* Design DNS, certificate, and network architecture for customer\-facing environments (Route 53 delegation, ACM, VPC design).
* Contribute to landing zone evolution, account vending, and multi\-environment promotion patterns.


**Automation \& Operations**


* Build and harden CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions for infrastructure and application delivery.
* Operate and optimize containerized and serverless workloads (ECS Fargate, EKS, Lambda) and RDS PostgreSQL at production scale.
* Instrument the platform with our OpenTelemetry\-based observability stack (OpenObserve, CloudWatch) and integrate with PagerDuty.
* Own incident response and root cause analysis for cloud infrastructure in your domain, meeting SLA and SLO targets.
* Drive FinOps outcomes: tagging enforcement, right\-sizing, Savings Plans coverage, and cost anomaly follow\-up.


**Security \& Compliance**


* Implement cloud security best practices: IAM boundary design, secrets management, network segmentation, and encryption standards.
* Partner with Information Security to enforce SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls and produce audit evidence through automation.
* Integrate vulnerability scanning, patching, and policy checks into pipelines (shift\-left security).
* Uphold Amtech's data governance rules for customer data in all cloud environments.


**AI Competency**


* Design validation gates for AI\-assisted infrastructure changes: what AI may touch, required review depth by blast radius, and rollback and audit trails.
* Establish reusable AI patterns (prompt and context libraries, standard workflows) adopted across the pod, and mentor engineers in safe, high\-leverage usage.
* Measure AI productivity impact against baselines; enforce data classification policy in all AI\-assisted work.


**Collaboration \& Leadership**


* Partner with product development teams to enable efficient, self\-service deployment models.
* Mentor earlier\-career platform engineers in IaC, observability, and secure delivery practices.
* Coordinate daily with U.S. peers and leadership to maintain global consistency across time zones.
* Contribute to architectural reviews, migration planning, and platform standards.


 **QUALIFICATIONS**


* 7\+ years of hands\-on experience in cloud, platform, or DevOps engineering, with substantial AWS depth.
* Expert working knowledge of AWS services (EC2, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS, IAM, Lambda, VPC, Route 53\) in multi\-account environments.
* Strong Terraform expertise, including designing reusable modules consumed by other teams.
* Proven software engineering ability in Python (or similar) applied to platform automation.
* Experience with GitHub Actions or equivalent CI/CD, including secure pipeline design.
* Experience designing observability with OpenTelemetry or equivalent, and operating under SLOs.
* Strong grasp of networking, DNS, TLS, and cloud security architecture.
* Track record of effective collaboration in distributed global teams.
* Track record of team\-level AI leverage: designed validation gates for AI\-assisted changes and reusable patterns others adopted.
* Track record of team\-level AI leverage: designed validation gates for AI\-assisted changes and reusable patterns others adopted.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrated skills.


 **PREFERRED** **QUALIFICATIONS**


* AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional, Solutions Architect Professional, CKA, or Terraform Associate.
* Experience with account\-per\-customer or multi\-tenant SaaS hosting models, or ERP\-class workload migration (lift\-and\-shift and re\-platform).
* Experience with AWS Control Tower, landing zones, and account vending automation.
* FinOps practice experience (tagging governance, Savings Plans strategy, cost allocation).
* Experience operating AI/LLM workloads or building agentic automation under governance controls.


**W****hy Join Amtech**



At Amtech, you will drive meaningful financial impact in a growing enterprise software organization while benefiting from Vista’s world\-class ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented peers, leverage cross\-portfolio learning programs, and help shape the future of Amtech’s financial operations and systems. Build your career with Amtech — backed by the strength, scale, and innovation culture of Vista.

title: Senior/Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, Applied AI
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI\-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high\-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low\-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast\-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.


We are hiring a Staff Software Engineer for our Frontier Security AI team. Snowflake's Frontier Security AI teams develop production\-grade LLM applications, intelligent agents, AI infrastructure, and evaluation systems for enterprise customers — products that must meet a high bar for quality, security, reliability, and efficiency while operating over sensitive data at large scale. In this role, you will lead the design and development of our Agentic Harness and agent evaluation platform, working across product, infrastructure, applied AI, security, and modeling teams to take new capabilities from prototype to dependable customer value.

**AS A STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:**
--------------------------------------------------------

* Architect and build the Agentic Harness that executes complex, multi\-step AI workflows across models, tools, data, and services.
* Design stable interfaces for tool execution, context construction, state management, memory, permissions, retries, fallbacks, and human review.
* Own agent quality end to end by building evaluation harnesses, representative datasets, automated graders, experiment pipelines, and release gates.
* Convert ambiguous reports such as "the agent feels worse" into measurable failure modes, reproducible tests, and durable fixes.
* Analyze production agent trajectories to identify failures in reasoning, retrieval, tool use, context, orchestration, and application code.
* Close the loop between production incidents, root\-cause analysis, evaluation coverage, and regression prevention.
* Develop offline and online measurements for task completion, correctness, groundedness, safety, latency, reliability, and cost.
* Build simulation and replay infrastructure for golden\-set tests, adversarial scenarios, model comparisons, and large\-scale experiments.
* Improve agent efficiency through model routing, prompt and semantic caching, context compaction, tool\-result management, and token optimization.
* Productionize new model capabilities as secure, observable, multi\-tenant services with clear operational controls.
* Establish standards for evaluation design, including sampling, ground\-truth quality, grader calibration, leakage prevention, and statistical significance.
* Define technical direction across multiple teams and lead projects whose scope extends beyond a single service.
* Mentor engineers, raise the quality of architecture reviews, and remain directly involved in implementation and debugging.

**OUR IDEAL STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:**
------------------------------------------------

* 9\+ years of software engineering experience, including technical leadership of complex production systems.
* Direct experience shipping and operating LLM applications, AI agents, or model\-backed workflows in production.
* Strong background in distributed systems, service architecture, high\-throughput APIs, concurrency, and failure handling.
* Experience building an agent runtime, workflow engine, developer platform, evaluation system, or similar infrastructure.
* Demonstrated ability to evaluate nondeterministic systems without relying on a single aggregate score.
* Fluency in Python and strong proficiency in at least one systems or application language such as Java, Go, Rust, or TypeScript.
* Hands\-on knowledge of tool calling, structured generation, retrieval, context engineering, prompt management, and model APIs.
* Experience with production observability, including structured traces, replay, metrics, logs, and incident diagnosis.
* Ability to balance agent quality with latency, reliability, security, and inference cost.
* Track record of setting technical direction and delivering results across organizational boundaries.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Clear written and verbal communication with engineering, product, and leadership audiences.

**BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:**
-----------------------------------

* Building evaluation or observability infrastructure for agentic coding, data engineering, or analytics systems.
* Designing human\-evaluation programs, scoring rubrics, annotation workflows, or grader\-calibration methods.
* Working with multi\-agent orchestration, long\-running agents, asynchronous workflows, or durable execution.
* Developing synthetic tasks, simulations, adversarial tests, red\-team exercises, or safety guardrails.
* Building retrieval systems that use vector search, hybrid search, semantic indexing, ranking, or caching.
* Operating multi\-tenant systems that process sensitive enterprise data.
* Working with model training, fine\-tuning, reinforcement learning, or feedback\-driven optimization.
* Evaluating and onboarding frontier models based on measured product outcomes.
* Experience with databases, SQL engines, data platforms, Kubernetes, or cloud\-native infrastructure.

**YOU MAY BE A PARTICULARLY GOOD FIT IF YOU:**
----------------------------------------------

* Treat evaluation as part of product engineering rather than a final validation step.
* Can move between agent behavior, distributed infrastructure, data analysis, and production debugging.
* Question metrics that do not reconcile and design tests that can expose misleading results.
* Take ownership from early architecture through deployment, operations, and measurable customer outcomes.
* Prefer evidence from representative tasks and production behavior over isolated benchmark results.
* Work effectively in fast\-moving environments where requirements develop through experimentation.


Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.


How do you want to make your impact?

* Excellent written and verbal communications skills, to serve as lead conduit between developers, architects, designers and with external and internal customers Will help Customer care team in resolving maintenance SRs

**Required Experience / Skills:**

* Airline Offer Optimization and Management knowledge and experience
* 8\+ years experience working in Revenue Management, Pricing and associated ML and OR models for an airline using O\&D revenue management solutions, or similar experience
* Strong Data Analytical skills
* Ability to apply modelling and analytical skills to real world travel problems demonstrated

Must be willing to travel 30\-50% of the time

title: Engineering Manager
description:

If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high\-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!


Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a **Manager, R\&D** to be a part of making this happen  



  

**Position Overview and Objective**  

  

The manager for Vulnerability Management team has a strong backend development skills ( **Python, Go)** , hands\-on cloud experience ( **AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform)** , and deep familiarity with automation testing using test management tools like X\-ray or similar, CI/CD (GitHub Actions). They bring experience managing high\-performing teams and building test environments to improve quality of the product as well as emerging AI/LLM technologies ( **AWS Bedrock Flows, Databricks MLFlow** ). **Responsibilities**

* Secure Coding Practice.
* Acceptable Use.

Bachelor’s degree (BS) or Master’s degree (MS) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field is required.

**About Arctic Wolf**  



At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021\-2025\), Best Places to Work – USA (2021\-2025\), Great Place to Work – Canada (2021\-2024\), Great Place to Work – UK (2024\-2026\), and Kununu Top Company – Germany (2024\-2026\). As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry.  

  



**Our Values**  



Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that—by protecting people’s and organizations’ sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk— we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good.


We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance.


We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities.

Employee Assistance Program

Please let us know if you require any accommodation by emailing recruiting@arcticwolf.com. View our Hiring Page to learn more about our application process.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Role Description:
**The Job**
===========


We are looking for an Engineering Manager to join our team and help us to move the Customer Service Tech at Booking to the next level. Your role is to enable your team and help each team member to achieve their goals. You get things done via influence, not authority. You unlock the creativity of your team and inspire them to build the best for our customers. You take full responsibility for your area.

  

As an Engineering Manager, you are responsible for one or two engineering teams and the technology (Pega and Backend) that the teams own. You will not only work as a coach for your team members but also as a technical leader, ensuring that the right technical decisions are made when building our product.


We expect you to have the energy and passion to deliver solutions using a whole range of PEGA centric technologies and have a solid understanding of engineering principles.


 You will collaborate with colleagues in Amsterdam to achieve results the right way. This will include other Engineering Managers , Product Managers , Operations and Service Excellence teams.

**Key Responsibilities and Duties**
-----------------------------------

* Manage 1 or more teams of software, data \& reliability engineers \- between 5 and 10 people in total
* Create a culture of ownership and technical excellence, leading by example
* Empower engineers to develop their careers by providing ad\-hoc applicable coaching
* Help building and enriching an inclusive work environment comprised of people from diverse backgrounds
* Contribute to projects by guiding architectural discussions, providing technical coaching to software engineers and occasionally getting hands\-on with coding
* Champion engineering and operational excellence, establishing metrics and processes to both supervise health and allow continuous improvement
* Provide technical guidance to both your team members and your project peers
* Drive team efforts to establish bottom\-up projects and roadmaps supporting our vision
* Collaborate closely with the team in Amsterdam to drive the delivery of common goals
* Drive initiatives to reduce operational workload, introduce monitoring at scale, and improve debugging, testing, validation, and data quality for production\-ready data products.
* Oversee infrastructure upgrades, migrations, and cost optimization for data products, while ensuring our success metrics are consistently delivered.
* Works in conjunction with Senior Engineering Manager to size, manage scope and risk
* Collaborate with your Product counterpart to design and deliver solutions with customer centric outcomes
* Ownership of the quality of the solutions your team produce
* Embed Agile ways of working and values within your team
* Contribute to the evolution of best practices across the department

**The job requirements**
========================

* At least 3\+ years of experience leading and managing a team of engineers in a fast\-paced and complex environment
* 6\+ years of experience in Pega
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer or Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field or 5 years of progressively responsible experience in the specialty as equivalent
* A deep understanding of software development in a team, and a track record of developing and shipping software
* Familiarity with agile best practices for the full software development life cycle such as Pega coding standards, code reviews, deployment and version control.
* Solid understanding of cloud technologies and how they can be leveraged to solve problems at scale
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and cooperate with people at all levels
* Experience in working on products with a large customer base and company wide impact
* Strong Coding \& System design skills with ability to get hands\-on with your team if needed
* You are a humble and thoughtful technology leader, you lead by example and gain your teammates’ respect through actions, not the title
* Experience working with teams located in different timezones is a plus

 **Preferred**

* PEGA Certified Lead Systems Architect
* Experience in architecting and designing Pega based CRM solutions for large programmes
* Experience of building robust and resilient PEGA systems

title: Solution Architecture - HCL Commerce
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We're looking for a seasoned **Solution Architect** with HCL Commerce expertise to drive the design and evolution of a multi\-tier B2B commerce platform, steering architecture decisions across legacy Commerce systems, Spring Boot services, and modern Next.js storefronts.

**Responsibilities**

* Establish and maintain target and transitional architecture for multi\-tier B2B commerce, covering WCS store, business logic, Commerce tools, Spring Boot APIs, and Next.js / React storefront
* Direct the design of dual\-run / strangler patterns, deciding which journeys stay on WCS and which move to Next.js and services, while ensuring routing, session, catalog, cart, and order consistency, and establishing cut\-over and rollback procedures
* Create and review solution designs, sequence/integration diagrams, and interface contracts (REST/SOAP), flagging reusability, performance, security, and operability issues before build
* Collaborate with product, delivery leads, QA, DevOps, and enterprise/integration teams on requirements, data conversion, integration testing, and cut\-over activities
* Set coding and design standards for Commerce customization, Spring Boot services, and Next.js storefront to keep squads aligned
* Oversee integration with back\-end systems (ERP, payments, search, CMS, punchout / customer purchasing systems), keeping a clear separation between Preview (authoring) and Runtime (customer\-facing) Commerce environments
* Assess designs and pull requests across Commerce, services, and storefront layers, tracking down complex cross\-layer defects to their root cause
* Provide guidance on capacity planning, caching strategies, search, and failure modes for a high\-traffic B2B storefront
* Coach senior engineers and leads, and document architecture decisions with context, options, and consequences to preserve continuity
* Spot key barriers and use structured problem\-solving methods for complex, multi\-system challenges

**Requirements**

* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 12\-20 years in professional software engineering, including at least 5 years as an architect or in an equivalent principal/staff design capacity on large\-scale commerce or comparably complex multi\-tier systems
* At least 8 years working with HCL Commerce and/or IBM WebSphere Commerce (WCS) 8\.x, spanning store customization, commands/tasks, tools, catalog/order/user/organization flows, and back\-end integration
* At least 8 years of experience in Java / J2EE and object\-oriented design on large IT systems, with a strong preference for WebSphere Application Server background
* At least 5 years working with Spring / Spring MVC, with hands\-on experience architecting Spring Boot solutions, including service boundaries, APIs, resilience, and authentication
* At least 5 years working with REST and SOAP web services, with the capability to define contracts for other teams to build against
* Hands\-on production architecture experience with Next.js and React, covering routing, data fetching, BFF/API integration, and storefront performance, with TypeScript knowledge preferred
* At least 5 years using source control systems, with required Git proficiency
* Preferred background in designing B2B commerce architecture, including punchout functionality, organizational/user models, and contract/pricing complexity
* Familiarity with Agile delivery methods using Atlassian tooling (Jira, Bitbucket/Git, Confluence)
* Strong written and verbal communication abilities suited to both technical and non\-technical audiences

**Nice to have**

* Familiarity with headless/composable commerce concepts (API\-first storefronts, BFF, packaged capabilities) and MuleSoft or comparable iPaaS platforms
* Exposure to search technologies (Solr or similar), caching solutions (Redis or similar), and CMS\-driven storefronts (Optimizely or similar) working alongside a commerce engine
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (GKE/Kubernetes or similar) for storefront and Spring Boot deployment, plus WAS/IHS knowledge for Commerce
* Working knowledge of security practices, PCI\-adjacent payment flows, and session/identity management spanning legacy and modern storefronts
* Prior involvement in dual\-run setups or large\-scale commerce migration initiatives

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. AI\-First. Future\-Driven. Human\-Centered.
  
At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
  
  

Your Impact
  
OpenText enables the digital world as the global leader in Enterprise Information Management, both on\-cloud and off\-cloud. We embrace all things digital and are committed to being the Best Place to Work for our Employees in over 140 locations around the world.We obsess over our customers to ensure they are wildly successful in embracing the Digital World. The Open Text Professional Services team is comprised of more than 3,000 consultants who function as trusted advisors, managing long\-lasting relationships with more than 100,000 customers around the world. They are responsible for the delivery of business solutions from pre\-sales to post implementation. Our teams of experts help organizations solve issues, create value, improve business performance, and work more effectively in an increasingly digital world.
  
As a Sr. Consultant at OpenText Professional Services team you will play a key role in creating and delivering strategic, impactful, and integrated digital solutions for clients using a combination of OpenText technologies. This role offers an opportunity to leverage your expertise in OpenText xECM configuration, knowledge of SAP business processes and integration to deliver seamless solutions that bridge the world of information and business application.

* Engaging with enterprise architects, business, and IT stakeholders of client to understand their business processes, technology landscape and functional requirements in order to define integrated digital solutions for their business problems.
* Planning and conducting business workshops with business and IT stakeholders of the client to elicit and document business and technical requirements for complex digital solutions.

* Analyzing and debugging of complex functional, design and implementation issues related to the solution and preparation of RCA. Mentoring and guiding technical architects and senior developers within the team with professional and technical advice.

description:

The Google Cloud team helps companies, schools, and government seamlessly make the switch to Google products and supports them along the way. You work closely with a cross\-functional team of web developers and systems administrators, not to mention a variety of both regional and international customers. As an AI Outcome Customer Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), you will be responsible as an enterprise architect, technical debugger, and engineering liaison. You will bridge the gap between pre\-sales agreement shaping and post\-sales execution. Entering the agreement cycle during the technical evaluation phase for strategic accounts, you will ensure that solutions are shaped strictly through the lens of adoption, rapid activation, and viable delivery. You will be the overarching Enterprise Architect and Technical Delivery Manager charting the course. You will also be responsible for technical design, systemic debugging, product and engineering integration, and strategic FDE alignment. Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

* Partner with Account teams and practice Customer Engineer (CEs) during technical evaluation phases to assess project feasibility, shape proposals for long\-term adoption, and validate FDE engagement requests.

title: Software Engineering Lead (GO & Python, AWS)
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

  



We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join the Enterprise Logging team and lead development of a next\-generation log processing pipeline. This role is responsible for designing, building, and operating a high\-throughput Lambda\-based consumer that transforms and delivers \~500 TB/day of cloud log data from AWS, GCP, and Azure into Splunk Cloud. The ideal candidate has deep experience with streaming data systems, multi\-cloud environments, and building production\-grade data pipelines on a scale.

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Design and develop a serverless event processing pipeline (AWS Lambda) that reads from Kinesis Data Streams, transforms events, and delivers CIM\-compliant payloads to Splunk Cloud via HTTP Event Collector (HEC)
* Implement event parsing and transformation logic across multiple cloud log formats (CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs, GCP Audit Logs, Azure Activity Logs, and others)
* Build and maintain source/source type mapping configurations supporting 59,000\+ unique log type combinations
* Develop tiered data routing logic (Keep / Reduce / Skip) to optimize Splunk licensing costs
* Implement timestamp extraction and normalization across heterogeneous event formats
* Operate and monitor the pipeline in production \- build observability dashboards, alerting, and error handling (dead\-letter queues, retry logic)
* Collaborate with the Centralized Logging team on Kinesis stream integration and Enhanced Fan\-Out configuration
* Participate in architecture decisions, code reviews, and CI/CD pipeline development
* Write infrastructure as code (Terraform or CloudFormation) for all deployed components
* Contribute data standards and onboarding documentation for new log sources
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Cloud Platforms (Multi\-Cloud)
	+ AWS (primary): Solid hands\-on experience with Lambda, Kinesis Data Streams, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, PrivateLink, DynamoDB, and SQS
	+ GCP: Working knowledge of Cloud Logging, Pub/Sub, IAM, and GCP audit log formats
	+ Azure: Working knowledge of Event Hubs, Activity Logs, Diagnostic Logs, Storage Accounts, and Azure Monitor
* Streaming \& Data Engineering
	+ Experience building high\-throughput streaming pipelines (Kinesis, Kafka, or equivalent)
	+ Experience with data serialization formats (JSON, AVRO, Protobuf) and compression (gzip, base64 encoding)
	+ Understanding of event\-driven architecture and at\-least\-once delivery semantics
	+ Familiarity with fan\-out patterns, backpressure handling, and shard\-level parallelism
* Software Development
	+ 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience
	+ Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or equivalent)
	+ Experience writing and maintaining infrastructure as code (Terraform preferred; CloudFormation acceptable)
	+ Proficiency in Go (primary) with experience writing and maintaining production Lambda functions; the existing consumer is implemented in Go
	+ Solid understanding of error handling patterns: exponential backoff, dead\-letter queues, circuit breakers
	+ Proficiency in Python (secondary) for tooling, automation, and supporting services
	+ Proficiency with Git\-based workflows, code review practices, and trunk\-based development
* Observability \& Operations
	+ Experience building monitoring and alerting data pipelines for production
	+ Understanding of distributed systems failure modes and operational runbook development
	+ Familiarity with CloudWatch Metrics, Logs, and Alarms (or equivalent observability stack)

 **What You'll Be Building**


This is not a maintenance role. You will be building a greenfield, high\-scale data pipeline that:

* Processes \~500 TB/day across three major cloud providers
* Transforms events from a legacy AVRO\-wrapped format into CIM\-compliant native payloads
* Directly enables Splunk Enterprise Security detection capabilities (correlation searches, data model acceleration)
* Implements intelligent data tiering to reduce licensing costs by tens of terabytes per day

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

The AI Architect defines and guides scalable, maintainable, AI\-enabled product architecture for modern product delivery and legacy modernization.
